description_en: Encrypts an original phone number into a virtual number that starts with 140. You can use the encrypted number to initiate voice calls by integrating with Alibaba Cloud communication services
description_zh: 将原始号码加密为一个140开头的虚拟号码。通过结合阿里云的通信服务，可以使用加密后的140号码发起语音呼叫。实现虚拟号码呼叫的效果
name: PhoneNumberEncrypt

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

On the My Applications page in the Phone Number Service console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)我的申请页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to be queried.

Only a single phone number can be queried at a time
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的号码。

目前仅支持单个号码查询
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method for the phone number. Valid value: NORMAL.


<notice>Only the NORMAL encryption method is supported.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
号码的加密方式。取值：NORMAL。


<notice>目前仅支持NORMAL加密方式。></notice>
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en: The custom ID specified by the user. This parameter is optional. The format is not limited, and the length cannot exceed 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定的outId，选填，格式不限，长度小于等于64
parameters.name: out_id

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

A value of OK indicates that the request is successful.

For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。

其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the phone number

OutId.description_en:
The custom ID reserved for the caller when the request is initiated. This ID is ultimately returned to the caller.

The value is a string and can be up to 64 characters in length
OutId.description_zh:
发起请求时预留给调用方的自定义ID，最终、将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度限制为最长为64个字符

Message.description_en: The description of the returned status code
